senses: to deal out to, do to
(Qal) to wean a child (Niphal) to be weaned

strongs.def: to treat a person (well or ill), i.e. benefit or requite; by implication (of toil), to ripen, i.e. (specifically) to wean
strongs.kjv: bestow on, deal bountifully, do (good), recompense, requite, reward, ripen, [phrase] serve, mean, yield
